origin_private_windows_repairs.repair: Compare against subprocess.list2cmdline of the exact allowlisted argv on Windows, and verify executable plus cwd. No broad command permission. POSIX retains exact argv comparison.

origin_private_windows_repairs.cause: Windows Popen defaults the explicit executable audit argument to None, although argv has the interpreter. The separate executable identity assertion rejected that None before launch.
origin_private_windows_repairs.repair: Pass executable=sys.executable explicitly to Popen. Retain exact command-line, exact executable and exact cwd allowlist checks. No mathematical code, parameters, scopes, or checks change.
